text: *Draft 1:* If you're thinking about upgrading your e-bike for the daily commute, you might want to wait a bit. Technology is moving so fast. With battery density improving and prices dropping, the newer models are significantly lighter and more efficient. Plus, the latest mid-drive motors are becoming much more affordable. Unless your current bike is failing you or making your commute unsafe, holding out for the next cycle of product releases usually turns out to be the smarter move for your wallet and your back.
